personalities.name: Hikaru Nakamura
personalities.description: American chess grandmaster and Twitch/YouTube streamer known for bullet chess and reactions to Magnus Carlsen.

personalities.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
personalities.description: American politician, environmental lawyer, and vaccine skeptic; known for his raspy voice and conspiracy-adjacent views.

personalities.name: Sherlock Holmes
personalities.description: Fictional consulting detective created by Arthur Conan Doyle; famously arrogant, deductive, violin-playing, cocaine-using.

personalities.name: Demis Hassabis
personalities.description: Co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind; former chess prodigy and game designer; Nobel laureate (chemistry, 2024).

personalities.name: Stephen Curry
personalities.description: NBA superstar point guard for the Golden State Warriors; greatest 3-point shooter of all time; relatively small for the NBA.

personalities.name: Sam Altman
personalities.description: CEO of OpenAI; former Y Combinator president; known for prepper hobbies, a soft voice, and his board-firing-then-rehiring saga.

personalities.name: Lisa Manoban
personalities.description: Thai rapper and singer; member of K-pop group BLACKPINK; solo artist, fashion icon, and Celine ambassador.

personalities.name: Alex Honnold
personalities.description: American rock climber famous for free-solo (no ropes) ascents, including El Capitan; subject of the documentary Free Solo.

personalities.name: Jon Stewart
personalities.description: American comedian and political commentator; longtime host of The Daily Show; returned in 2024.

personalities.name: Dario Amodei
personalities.description: Co-founder and CEO of Anthropic; former OpenAI VP of research; known for long essays about AI safety and 'Machines of Loving Grace'.
